title: 2025, Bluffdale City Council, LBA & RDA Meeting Agenda 01-08-2025

votes.motion: Council Member Crockett moved to APPROVE the December 11, 2024, City Council Meeting Minutes and Agenda, as presented. Council Member Aston seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-03 - Bluffdale City Emergency Operations Plan, with the addition of the Herriman Police Department and the addition of the Public Works Building as a third possible site. Council Member Austin seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-04 - Salt Lake County Emergency Management Plan, with the addition of the Mayor or Designee to Section 2.1.3. Council Member Austin seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Crockett moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-01 - Designating the Appointment of a Mayor Pro Tempore Pursuant to Bluffdale Code 1.60.030(B)(4). Council Member Wilding seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent ofthe Council

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-05 — Designating the Appointment of a Representative for the Association of Municipal Councils Pursuant to Bluffdale Code 1.60.030(7). Council Member Crockett seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-06- Appointing Individuals to the City of Bluffdale Audit Committee. Council Member Wilding seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-07 — Appointing Individuals to the City of Bluffdale Budget Review Committee. Council Member Austin seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE Ordinance 2025-01 - Proposed Text Amendment to Chapter 3.10 Business License Provisions to Allow ^'Enclosed Mobile Businesses" in Bluffdale and Chapter 3.80 Home Occupations to Allow Home-Based Microschools and Micro-Education Facilities as Home Occupations, as Permitted by State Law. Council Member Austin seconded the motion

Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE Ordinance 2025-02 — Proposed Text Amendment to Section 11.220 of the Bluffdale City Land Use Regulations to Amend Temporary Signage. Council Member Wilding seconded the motion

Council Member Austin moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-02 - Declare Surplus Property at Bluffdale Heights Park for Use by Allwest for Telecommunications Equipment and Lease Agreement. Council Member Aston seconded the motion
Trustee Austin moved to ADJOURN the LBA Meeting. Trustee Aston seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the LBA

votes.motion: Board Member Lord moved to ADJOURN. Board Member Wilding seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent ofthe RDA

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to go into a CLOSED MEETING to Discuss Litigation. Council Member WUding seconded the motion
Council Member Aston moved to ADJOURN. Council Member Austin seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council
